options: interest groups contacting parliament and government
quiz.answer: interest groups contacting parliament and government

goodToKnow: Der Lobbyismus is lobbying, interest groups trying to influence politicians. Since 2022, a Lobbyregister at the Bundestag requires lobbyists to register and disclose clients and budgets. The neutral term is die Interessenvertretung. Organisations like LobbyControl criticise undue influence, for example in the automotive and pharmaceutical sectors. Der Lobbyist is a lobbyist. It has no plural.
